result.topic_en: Notes on many-valued functions, branch points and the two-dimensional manifold defined by F(s,z)=0, and on multiple connectivity: closed curves that together form the complete boundary of a surface piece, the expressibility of integrals around some curves through others, and cross-cuts (Querschnitte) dissecting a surface.
